review.summary:
changes_needed
Country-coded identifiers remain beside the renamed Week 6 site.
Review settings still expose the UTC+8 offset.
Checks passed: 23 tests; link checker reports bad 0.

findings.checklist_item: Keep it anonymous: use neutral site prefixes without country or place hints
findings.title: Neutralize the remaining site identifiers in the Task example
findings.claim: The example changes the site to PVA-03 but retains its country-coded spelling in the task ID and fixture/reference paths, making the anonymization incomplete.
findings.evidence: The Task still contains id="sg03-1008-curtail", fixture="fixtures/sg03-1008/", and reference="ref/sg03-1008.ticket.json" immediately beside input={"site": "PVA-03", ...}. A case-insensitive search found these three remaining identifiers.
findings.proposed_change: Replace sg03 with pva03 in all three example strings. Repeat the anonymity search with case-insensitive patterns that also catch site identifiers without hyphens, then rerun pytest.

findings.checklist_item: Keep it anonymous: remove location and time-zone hints
findings.title: Remove the remaining UTC+8 hint from the review settings
findings.claim: Replacing the location name with its UTC offset retains the time-zone hint this pass is intended to remove.
findings.evidence: The diff changes '# Singapore day' to '# UTC+8 day'. The offset remains explicit despite the PR's stated removal of time-zone hints from review settings.
findings.proposed_change: Remove the offset from the comment, or describe it as the harness-defined daily window. Keep the setting and runtime behavior unchanged, and repeat the time-zone search.
